learning_objective: 🎯 Let us go on a treasure hunt and learn the words that tell us where things are hiding!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Prepositions are little position words! They tell us exactly where a person, place, animal, or thing is.
The cat can be IN the box, ON the box, or UNDER the box! These tiny words change where the cat is completely.
If you are playing hide and seek, you might hide BEHIND the door. If you sit with Mom on one side and Dad on the other, you are sitting BETWEEN them!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Teddy Bear Hide and Seek!
fun_activity.instructions: Take your favorite teddy bear and a chair. Put the teddy ON the chair, UNDER the chair, and BEHIND the chair. Say the preposition out loud each time!

quick_recap: ⭐ They link a noun or pronoun to other words in a sentence.
⭐ Examples include in, on, under, behind, and between.
